parent_objective: design a hidden-use repair objective after M591 finds action-equivalent real hidden states

public_gates: design hidden-use objective or corpus before implementation
preserve P0 human-view no-wheel no-oracle actor inputs
avoid action-separation losses that are not tied to capability or outcome evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train or run PPO
do not add hidden vehicle parameters wheel slip tire force or oracle labels to actor inputs
do not push actions apart solely for the sake of hidden sensitivity
do not treat random-hidden sensitivity as self-ID proof
hypothesis: Because M591 shows a structural hidden path but action-equivalent real rollout hidden states, the next repair should train hidden state to encode future response or capability on matched-current histories before attempting PPO or action-level repair.
success_criteria: design selects the first hidden-use repair objective or corpus
design specifies training-only targets and confirms they do not enter deployable actor inputs
design specifies exact validation gates for hidden prediction and action sensitivity
design blocks PPO and promotion until hidden-use evidence improves
failure_criteria: design adds oracle or wheel/slip inputs to the actor
design proposes action separation without capability or outcome grounding
design jumps directly to PPO continuation

commands.name: design
commands.command: Write hidden-use repair objective/corpus design after M591; no training or promotion.

decision_rule: M592 passes because it defines a no-oracle hidden-use repair objective grounded in future response/capability evidence and pre-registers validation before implementation.
